source.prompt: Generated via Cloudflare AI Gateway (gateway kaede-assets, unified billing) with google/nano-banana-2, image_input = the base character's stand frame as a style reference only (~$0.10 — the ①b(a) layer-composition spike, 2026-08-08). Prompt: 'Using the reference image only as an art-style guide (cute chibi cartoon game sprite style, clean bold outlines, soft cel shading, warm colors), draw ONE simple ceramic coffee mug as a game item sprite: a white mug with a curved handle on the right side, filled with brown coffee visible from a slight top-down 3/4 angle, a tiny wisp of steam above it. The mug is a small hand-held prop sized for a chibi character to hold in one fist. Draw ONLY the mug, centered, large, on a completely flat pure green #00FF00 chroma-key background. No character, no table, no shadow, no text. Constant even lighting.' First try was accepted. heightPx 16 (2x resolution = 8 logical px) was chosen by compositing 14/16/20 onto every pose frame at the measured hand anchors and eyeballing at game scale; grip [0.5, 0.55] centers the mug body slightly below middle so the fist reads as wrapping the mug, not the rim.
